Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' At the start. ' and its description reads ' Honestly, just a normal brid. In fact, so normal that it has won the National Normal award of Bridtopia for 6 straight years in a row. No tricks, no weird distractions, /e verynormal, none of that. Just a normal brid living a normal life, with no obstructions whatsoever. None. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the first Brid. Before the precise rating system was removed, this Brid's rating was 1.00. In this Brid's aforementioned description, the code for Upside-Down Brid is hidden.

docs.text: Overview Brids are the main collectible in the game. As of this writing, there are 170 Brids in the game, ranging from trivially easy to unimaginably difficult. All Brids in the game are given a special name and design that is unique to them only. Statistics Main Stats Each Brid is given five main statistics, those being Area, Description, Difficulty, Hint, and Series. Area: The location in which a Brid is in. The area is not actually decided by where the Brid is at, but where the Brid starts, which in many cases overlap. However, in the case of Brids in sub-areas, this is necessary. Some Brids are in subrealms, in which case the Area is the name of the subrealm they are in. Description: The description of the Brid. This is sometimes picked by the creator of the Brid, but in many cases the Brids are given descriptions to fit the Find the Brids lore. Difficulty: The indication of how hard the Brid is to obtain. In order, the difficulties are Freebie, Easy, Medium, Hard, Challenging, Worrying, Extreme, Inhuman, Supreme, Impossible, Transcendant. The difficulties in the extreme-inhuman range are classified as 'mind-numbing', with them taking at least a decent amount of skill to obtain. Any Brid in the Transcendant difficulty is classified as 'brain-shattering' due to them needing extremely immense skill in puzzle solving/obbying. Hint: A bit of information to help steer Brid hunters in the right direction when looking for the Brid. Series: A set of Brids with a common idea are sometimes grouped into a Series. The only two series that exist as of writing this are Troll and Secret. Substatistics There are also four more statistics that are less important than the main ones, those being Badge ID, Credit, Is In Subrealm, and Required. Badge ID: The ID of the badge that is to be awarded when a player obtains the specified Brid. Credit: This is used internally to display who created the Brid in the Index. Is In Subrealm: This is also used internally to display an area correctly is a Brid is in a subrealm. Required: If the Brid is required, you must obtain it to complete the game. If not, the Brid is moved to a separate page within the Index and it is no longer required to complete the game. Trivia Brids are based off of a poorly drawn bird that the creator of the game drew on his homeroom teacher's whiteboard in his freshman year of high school.

docs.text: Overview Candy Cane Brid is a Brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 18, 2026. Obtainment Intended On the back of the candy cane in Ice, there is morse code. Decoding it gives you the text ' /e candycane10 '. Typing in candycane10 in the code inputter teleports you to the top of the candy cane where the Brid is. Alternate Wallhop up the candy cane in Ice and claim the Brid. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' A giant sweet treat. ' and its description reads ' I don't know if I should lick this thing. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the ninth Brid.

docs.text: Overview Helpless Brid is a Brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 18, 2026. Obtainment Get to the Omnimagical Brid area. ( For the obtainment of Omnimagical Brid, see its page. ) Next to the platform there is a truss. Climb to the top and the Brid is there. Trivia This Brid's hint reads " Somewhere magical... " and its description reads " He has nobody for him. He is alone in the world forever. " This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the fourth Brid. This Brid's subarea contains a button required for Delta Secret Brid. Before this Brid's area was revamped, it required you to dance clip outside of the Omnimagical Brid's box.

docs.text: Overview Omnimagical Brid is a Brid created by @Evanprice141 that was added on May 30, 2026. (Its original version was added January 18, 2026.) Obtainment On the candy-cane looking structure in the Void area, there is an eight-letter code. This code is a Pastebin link , which when visited reads " RHOLW]KPHKZPHLMXSZMX]IXHNJXKXIYT'4'T 'jpwoly.z'uhtl'pz'why{s 'hzzvjph{lk'~p{o'wsh nyv|uk'lx|pwtlu{5'^oh{'ht'PF'4'VTUP Good luck. ' This is an ASCII Shift Cipher shifted -7. Shifting it up to +7 reads ' KAHEPVDIADSIAEFQLSFQVBQAGCQDQBRM - My cipher's name is partly associated with playground equipment. What am I? - OMNI '. This is a Slidefair cipher, with the code being at the end (OMNI). Deciphering the ciphertext with the key gives you the text ' MYSTICALPOWERNINEZEROISYOURCODE '. Typing in ' /e mysticalpower90 ' in the code inputter will teleport you to the brid's subarea, where the Brid is just in front of you. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' Supporting a candy cane-like structure.. ' and its description reads ' Complete control over all things magical. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the third Brid. This Brid is the first Brid added to be considered 'mind-numbing', being the bare minimum difficulty for it, Extreme. This Brid had an original version. You can view it Its original version also had the first part of its puzzle hidden in the console and not on the structure. This Brid has always been linked to Helpless Brid since Helpless Brid was added, where Helpless Brid's subarea was a branch off of Omnimagical Brid's subarea in some way.
docs.title: Omnimagical Brid

docs.text: Overview Tree Brid is a Brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 18, 2026. Obtainment In the corner of Grassland, there is an obby encapsulating a tree. Complete the obby, get on top of the tree, and obtain the Brid. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' Up the tree. ' and its description reads ' Tre ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the sixth Brid. On the tree this Brid resides on, there is also a low-poly mesh model of a monkey on all fours.

docs.text: Overview Upside-Down Brid is a Brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 18, 2026. Obtainment In the description of the regular Brid, there is a /e code, being ' /e verynormal '. Typing ' verynormal ' into the code inputter teleports you under the Grassland island, where the Upside-Down Brid sits hanging upside-down from the grass above. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' Brid's description. ' and its description reads ' He got flipped. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the fifth Brid.
